name: Gletscherweg Kaunertal
kurzbeschreibung: The Kaunertal Glacier Trail in the rear Kaunertal is a gripping high-alpine educational trail at Gepatschferner glacier above 1,900 m, showcasing moraines and glacial geology.
beschreibung:
Überblick

The awe-inspiring Kaunertal Glacier Trail (Gletscherweg Kaunertal) traverses the primal high-alpine foreland situated at the head of the Kaunertal Valley directly beneath the Gepatschferner—Austria's second-largest glacier by surface area. Winding at altitudes between 1,900 and 2,100 metres, this educational geological trail leads walkers across terrain only uncovered by retreating ice in recent decades. The valley floor functions as a living outdoor laboratory where visitors observe nature pioneering bare rock in the wake of glacial retreat. Glaciated rock striations, monumental lateral moraines, thundering milky meltwater torrents, and fragile pioneer flora define the striking landscape. Framed by the glaciated three-thousand-metre peaks of the Ötztal Alps, the trail imparts captivating insights into climate history, glaciology, and alpine botany, allowing visitors to feel the tremendous sculptor force of ancient ice sheets.

Route & Anforderungen

The approximately five-kilometre loop trail commences near the historic Gepatschhaus mountain lodge or at the Fernergries car park along the Kaunertal Glacier Panorama Road. Total walking time occupies between two and two and a half hours, covering around 200 vertical metres of ascent and descent. Educational interpretive panels along the route explain glacier dynamics, historic ice limits, and botanical colonization by lichens and mountain avens. The footpath traverses rugged moraine singletracks, footbridges, and scree trails, demanding secure footing and basic stamina (unsuitable for baby strollers). Sturdy ankle-high mountaineering boots with deep rubber lugs, weatherproof layered clothing, and UV eye protection are essential at this high altitude.

Besuch & Anreise

Travelers take motorway A12 or expressway S16 to Landeck and continue along highway B180 to Prutz, where the Kaunertal road turns into the valley. Beyond the toll booth at Feichten, ascend the panoramic Kaunertal Glacier Road to the Gepatschhaus or Fernergries car park. Rail passengers alight at Landeck-Zams station and board local postbus line 230 through Feichten straight to the Gepatschhaus bus stop.

Tipps

Pair your glacier trek with a rustic meal at the historic Gepatschhaus: established in 1873 as Austria's first alpine club hut, its heritage stone-pine dining parlors serve traditional Tyrolean dumplings and fresh Kaiserschmarrn in an authentic historical atmosphere.
preis: Hiking trail freely accessible; toll applies for Kaunertal Glacier Road
oeffnungszeiten: Accessible during snow-free summer months from mid-June to mid-October
